spenden.headline: Your donation makes water safe to drink
spenden.impact.headline: What your donation can achieve
spenden.impact1: €5 a month gives around 20 children lasting access to clean drinking water every year, for example at their school.
spenden.impact2: €20 a month covers maintenance and spare parts for an existing filter, so that a village keeps its water clean for the long term.
spenden.impact3: €100 pays for the laboratory analysis of a water sample. It shows whether a new project needs a solution, and which one.
spenden.impact4: €1,500 funds a new AQQAcube that provides around 500 people with clean drinking water.
spenden.intro: WeWater is run by a dedicated team that works largely on a voluntary basis. To carry out our projects around the world and support them reliably, we depend on donations. Support us with a donation today!
spenden.tax.headline: Tax-deductible donations in Germany
spenden.tax1: WeWater gemeinnützige UG is exempt from corporate income tax as a non-profit organisation under Section 5(1) No. 9 of the German Corporate Income Tax Act (KStG), according to the annex to the 2024 corporate income tax notice issued by the Finanzamt für Körperschaften I (Bredtschneiderstraße 5, 14057 Berlin) on 3 July 2026. It serves exclusively and directly tax-privileged charitable purposes.
spenden.tax2: We confirm that donations are used solely to promote development cooperation in accordance with Section 52(2) sentence 1 No. 15 of the German Fiscal Code (AO).
spenden.taxForeign: The following information applies to taxpayers in Germany. If you pay taxes in another country, please check with your local tax authority whether your donation can be deducted there.
spenden.taxLarge: For donations over €300, we are happy to issue a donation receipt. Just send an email to hi@wewater.org with your full name and address, and we will email you the receipt.
spenden.taxSmall: Donations of up to €300 can be deducted without a separate donation receipt (Section 50(4) sentence 1 No. 2(b) EStDV). This applies to each individual donation, including monthly donations. Your bank statement together with this document (in German) is sufficient proof. Please keep both. The tax office will only ask for them if needed. Important: please state the purpose of each bank transfer (e.g. monthly donation, one-off donation) so that we can allocate your donation correctly.
spenden.taxStatute: You can find our articles of association <statuteLink>here</statuteLink> (in German).
spenden.trust1: We are officially recognised as a non-profit organisation by the German tax authorities.
spenden.trust2: Most of our team volunteers their time. To make sure our projects on the ground are well supported, we have a dedicated part-time project manager on board.
spenden.trust3: As a small organisation with flat hierarchies, we work lean and efficiently. We deliberately keep our costs low.
spenden.trust4: We work transparently: our articles of association are published, and on our blog and social media you can follow exactly what happens with your donation.
spenden.usage.headline: How we use donations
spenden.usage1: We want to show transparently what we use donations for. They mainly go into our projects: water filters, water infrastructure and workshops on the ground. In addition, there are small administrative costs, for example for website hosting, bank fees, fundraising, and legal and tax advice.
spenden.usage2: As the number of our projects grows, coordinating with our partner organisations, planning and reporting can no longer be handled by volunteers alone. That is why a part-time project manager has recently joined our team. He stays in close contact with our partners on the ground and makes sure that projects are carefully prepared, closely supported and documented in a traceable way. Everyone else on the team continues to volunteer.
